worldcombat.skill.lightscreen.summary: Raise a soft vertical screen at a chosen point, facing the cast direction: only special attacks that truly cross the screen from the outside toward allies behind it are cut, and their secondary effects are filtered down. Same-side attacks and hits that cross outside the screen's width or height land normally; the screen can be cleared by screen-breaking moves, and overlapping screens only apply the strongest one.
worldcombat.skill.lightscreen.use.0: Set a screen between a foe's ranged fire and your allies
worldcombat.skill.lightscreen.use.1: Block blanket special attacks coming through
worldcombat.skill.lightscreen.use.2: Place the screen before the foe's special push
worldcombat.skill.lightscreen.descriptio: The vertical screen stands at the chosen point, facing the cast direction; half-width %1$s, height %2$s, lasting about %3$s.
Special damage that crosses the screen from outside toward allies behind it is cut by %1$s, and the landing chance of a special move's secondary effect is filtered down by %2$s.
Same-side attacks, or a crossing point outside the screen's width/height, are not protected; with several screens hit at once only the strongest applies, never multiplied.
The screen can be placed at any point within %1$s blocks; its position is fixed and does not follow the caster.
worldcombat.skill.lightscreen.form.0: Thick: special cut x1.18, but only about six tenths of the thin screen's secondary filtering, +3 ticks wind-up, x1.12 cooldown - thicker head-on cover.
worldcombat.skill.lightscreen.form.1: Thin: special cut x0.8, but stronger secondary filtering (x1.3), -2 ticks wind-up, x0.9 cooldown - less raw cover, better against status and faster.
worldcombat.skill.lightscreen.timing: Cast on the ground within %1$s blocks: after %2$s of preparation it spends %4$s PP; the recovery is %3$s and the cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.lightscreen.preference: Thick: special cut x1.18, secondary filtering about six tenths of the thin screen, +3 ticks wind-up, x1.12 cooldown. Thin: cut x0.8, filtering x1.3, -2 ticks wind-up, x0.9 cooldown.
The partner only considers the screen while a threat is this close; smaller keeps it for melee pressure, larger prepares a screen position from farther away.
Under pressure: only while a foe is attacking the partner or its owner, or the partner was just hurt. Anytime: raise it on any threat.
When on, the screen is only raised while the partner or an ally within 6 blocks is below 65% health; off, it is raised on any threat.
When on, the partner will also leave its post to raise the screen.
